description: This file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically handling the search feature in the Home module. It initializes a search query from an HTTP request, executes a search, and handles exceptions/errors that may arise during the process.

classes.name: SearchThrowableHandler
classes.description: Handles exceptions or errors that occur during the search process, providing user-friendly error handling.

methods.name: handleThrowable
methods.description: Handles an exception or error, creating a SearchThrowableHandler instance to process it.
